name: arith_totient_pow_add_sigma_pow
statement: (n k : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) : 2 * n ^ k ≤ n.totient ^ k + ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 n ^ k
closed: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n), 2 * n ^ k ≤ n.totient ^ k + ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 n ^ k
informal: Power-mean extension of Sandor–Atanassov: φ(n)^k + σ(n)^k ≥ 2n^k for n ≥ 2 — Uses Mathlib2.p5_lemma2 at step 1 (φ + σ ≥ 2n), then convexity of x^k: ((a+b)/2)^k ≤ (a^k+b^k)/2 (inner_le_nnorm_mul_norm / add_pow_le_pow_mul_pow_of_add_eq_one, or induction on k via Chebyshev).
type: ∀ (n k : ℕ), 2 ≤ n → 2 * n ^ k ≤ n.totient ^ k + (ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1) n ^ k
